description: Expected and observed 95% CL upper limits on the signal cross section times the branching ratio of X → SH → b b $\gamma \gamma$ shown in the (mX, mS) plane, for each evaluated point. The values of the expected limit one and two standard deviations from the nominal value are also shown. The band at mS = 125 GeV is not included as these signal points are equivalent to those already probed in Phys. Rev. D 106 (2022) 052001.
